vetSays.line: 🛡️ Gunther, Leonora, Quinn and Wanjiru met them at the door — 4 put down. Gunther, Leonora, Quinn are hurt.
🛡️ Rachel, Franz, Gunther and Nathan met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Rachel, Franz, Gunther, Nathan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Franz just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Franz, Gunther, Nathan, Leonora and Quinn met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Franz, Gunther, Nathan, Leonora, Quinn are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big Loud (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Quinn. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Big Loud is still frozen from your scream.
Quinn strikes the Pack-leader Big Loud.
The Pack-leader Big Loud falls.
📺 Quinn brought down Pack-leader Big Loud, Big Loud (packmate). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Quinn brought down Pack-leader Big Loud, Big Loud (packmate). Together.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nathan just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nathan, Leonora and Mara met them at the door — 3 put down. Nathan, Mara are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Rachel taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Rachel drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Wanjiru: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Ugly Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Quinn. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader The Ugly Beast is still frozen from your scream.
Quinn whistles, sharp — The Pack-leader The Ugly Beast cocks its head and lurches toward the sound! (Goaded: its next move comes to them.)
Quinn strikes the Pack-leader The Ugly Beast.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Quinn SCREAMS — a sound like milk curdling in fast-forward. Its focus shatters. The The Scarred Loud-Eyes freezes. (stunned)
The Scarred Loud-Eyes is still frozen from your scream.
The Scarred Loud-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Loud-Eyes!
📺 You brought down Scarred Loud-Eyes. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Scarred Loud-Eyes.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
◈ THE WAR PATH — A moment of respect, from something that rarely respects. On day 94, you put down The Eulogy. On day 94, you put down The Algorithm — and 2 more teeth after.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Congregation and lived to sit here. They faced The Eater and lived to sit here. 1 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (1 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
